name: WMAP
summary: Historical NASA CMB mission whose precise anisotropy measurements established an important data foundation for dark-matter abundance and cosmological-model tests.
detection_principle: Differential microwave observations recover full-sky temperature and polarization maps; angular power spectra constrain baryons, cold dark matter and cosmic-expansion parameters.

status.label: Data taking ended / historical experiment
status.evidence: NASA explicitly identifies this as the end of science-data collection; analysis continued afterward.

collaboration.name: WMAP collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Only examples of lead or participating institutions directly established by the sources are listed. This is not a complete collaboration list, and listing does not imply equal institutional roles.

results.summary: Measured cosmic components using the CMB; this was not a laboratory discovery of dark-matter particles.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.

media.caption: Official artist's impression of WMAP near L2, showing dual reflectors and solar-shield structure; not an in-orbit photograph.
